{{samename|Pokémon franchise in {{wp|Jordan}}|Pokémon in the Arab world}} {{CharInfobox| |color={{contest color}} |corecolor={{contest color light}} |bordercolor={{contest color dark}} |name=Jordan |jname=サスケ |tmname=Sasuke |image=Jordan Adventures.png |size=150px |caption=Jordan in [[Pokémon Adventures]] |hometown=Unknown |region=[[Sinnoh]] |game=yes |generation={{gen|IV}} |games={{game3|Diamond and Pearl|Diamond, Pearl|s}}, {{v2|Platinum}} |gender=Male }} '''Jordan''' (Japanese: '''サスケ''' ''Sasuke'') is a character in {{game2|Diamond|Pearl|Platinum}}. He is one of the [[Contest Judge|judges]] of the [[Pokémon Super Contest]]s. His design is based on that of the {{tc|Rich Boy}} {{DL|Pokémon Trainer|Trainer class}}. ==In the games== Jordan appears in {{game2|Diamond|Pearl|Platinum}}. After the {{player}} has received a [[Poffin Case]] from the {{pkmn|Fan Club Chairman|Chairman}} of the [[Hearthome City]] [[Pokémon Fan Club]], Jordan will give them a level 60 [[Poffin|Mild Poffin]] with 40 [[smoothness]] when talked to. It is a unique Poffin that raises all of the five [[Contest condition|condition stats]] at once, which is impossible for Poffins that were made by the player. ===Items given=== {{Itlisth|normal}} {{Itemlist|Mild Poffin|sprite=Mild Poffin|size=40|In the [[Contest Hall|Super Contest Hall]]|D=yes|P=yes|Pt=yes|display=[[Poffin|Mild Poffin]]}} {{Itlistfoot|normal}} ===Quotes=== * If the player has not received a Poffin Case :''"You're going to enter Contests? But I don't see a Poffin Case. It could be tough for you to win Contests without it. But if you're determined to enter, don't let me stop you. It wouldn't hurt to get in some practice at the counter on the right."'' * If the player has received a Poffin Case :''"You're going to enter Contests? And, yup, you have a Poffin Case. Let me gift you with this fabulously wonderful Poffin!"'' :''"Feed that Poffin to a Pokémon you're going to enter in Contests. Oh, and a word of advice for you. Go take a run at the Contests! However, the best way to get ready is to get some practice first. You can take practice sessions at the counter on the right."'' :''"Like everything else, the basics are important. It takes practice to win Contests!"'' * If the player's Poffin Case is full :''"Oh, no. Your Poffin Case is full. I'll give it to you another time. Oh, and a word of advice. Go take a run at the Contests! ...That isn't much of a strategy. You might want some practice first. You can take practice sessions at the counter on the right."'' ===Sprites=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; font-size: 80%; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{contest color dark}}; background: #{{contest color}}" |- | style="{{roundy|80px}} border: 2px solid #{{contest color dark}}; background: #{{contest color light}}; width:96px; height:96px"| [[File:Rich Boy IV OD.png]] |- | Overworld sprite from
{{color2|000|Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Versions|Diamond, Pearl}}, and {{color2|000|Pokémon Platinum Version|Platinum}} |} ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== ===={{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}==== Jordan is a [[Contest Judge|judge]] for the [[Pokémon Super Contest]]s, similar to his in-game role. He debuted in ''[[PS351|Perturbed by Pachirisu]]'', in which he is seen judging a [[Rank (Contest)|Normal Rank]] [[Cool (condition)|Coolness Contest]]. In ''[[PS415|Double Trouble with Dialga and Palkia V]]'', he is seen with his fellow [[Contest Judge]]s at the [[Lost Tower]] after having been sent there because of the fight between {{p|Dialga}} and {{p|Palkia}} that caused time and space to distort. ===Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!=== Jordan appears in ''[[DPA06|Beauty Contest: The Pokémon Super Contest!!]]'' along with [[Dexter]] and [[Keira]] judging a [[Pokémon Super Contest]] in which [[Hareta]] and {{OBP|Jun|DPA}} were participating. ==Names== {| class="roundtable" style="background:#{{contest color}}; border:3px solid #{{contest color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{contest color light}}" | Language ! style="background:#{{contest color light}}" | Name ! style="background:#{{contest color light}}" | Origin |- | Japanese | サスケ ''Sasuke'' | |-und:#FFF" | English, Italian | Jordan | |- | German | Eric | |- | European Spanish | Claus | |- | French | Germain | |- | Korean | 진영 ''Jin-yeong'' | |- | Chinese (Traditional) | 佐助 ''Zuǒzhù'' / ''Jojoh'' | rowspan="2" | From the Japanese name 佐助 ''Sasuke'' |- | Chinese (Simplified) | 佐助 ''Zuǒzhù'' |} {{-}} ==Related articles== {{Super Contests Judges}} {{NPC|contest|sinnoh=yes}} {{Project CharacterDex notice}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Jordan}} [[Category:Diamond and Pearl characters]] [[Category:Platinum characters]] [[Category:Pokémon Adventures characters]] [[de:Eric]] [[es:Claus]] [[it:Jordan]] [[ja:サスケ]] [[zh:佐助]]
